## Known biases

Only claims on NFIP policies: uninsured, under-insured or out-of-programme losses are missing, and a claim exists only if the owner held a policy and filed. Locations are coarse (0.1 degree, block group) and the dataset is explicitly not an official federal report. Policies cluster in mapped floodplains, so pluvial losses outside them are under-counted.
